Subject: Invoice delivery preferences and billing contact setup (e-invoice vs. email)

Hi Emma / Brightline AP team,

Following up from our onboarding intake — we want to confirm how you'd like Redwood invoices to land in your AP system. Two quick options we support today:

1) Portal/API / e-invoice (preferred for larger customers)
   - We can push UBL or an API payload to your SFTP/API/portal connector.
   - Allows automatic PO matching and reduces manual processing.

2) Email (PDF)
   - We can send a signed PDF to an AP email alias (single address or a small fanout).

Questions for you (can you confirm in a reply):
- Which delivery channel do you prefer (Portal/API/UBL vs sent PDF to ap@brightline.com)?
- Do you require PO# on the subject or a specific filename pattern? If so, an example PO would be helpful.
- Remittance details: where should we route remittance notifications?
- VAT treatment: are you operating with reverse-charge for our services (we'll need the VAT registration to capture the correct line items)?

Attached are two small samples: a sample PDF we normally send and a UBL example so your AP/integration team can validate. If you prefer portal onboarding we can spin up a connector test and a 30-day canary for the first invoices.

Next steps from our side: once you confirm the preferred path we'll open a small onboarding ticket and loop in Kim (cc'd) for config and Ben on payments exceptions.

Thanks — trying to keep the first invoice flow painless.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Head of Strategic Accounts (EMEA/NA)
Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

- Remittance notifications should go to billing@brightline.com (please cc ap@brightline.com).
